pack.name: DonutStudio 3D Raymarch Worlds
pack.author: DonutStudio
pack.description: Raymarched 3D worlds for music videos: a note-built cathedral, a bass-driven nebula, a beat-folding fractal temple, a tuning-mapped spiral galaxy, a spectrum tunnel, an interference ocean, a pitch crystal cluster, a score monolith, a neural garden of harmonic links, a liquid depth pool, and a mix-powered fusion reactor. Every scene is driven by the score, exact JI tuning, harmonic links, clock, and audio analysis through the Block D camera contract.

shaders.name: Harmonic Cathedral
shaders.description: Every sounding note raises a glowing pillar in an orbiting 3D hall; pillar height follows pitch and the floor lattice lights up beneath each one. Transients kick light through the nave.

shaders.name: Bass Nebula
shaders.description: A volumetric nebula pumped by the low end: the camera drifts through fractal gas while each sounding note ignites a star placed by its exact cents offset from the root. Onsets detonate shockwave rings.

shaders.name: Fractal Bass Temple
shaders.description: An infinite Menger-style temple that folds open on the beat: bass carves the holes deeper, transients flood the central shaft with light, and sounding notes orbit as glowing runes.

shaders.name: Pitch Galaxy
shaders.description: A raymarched spiral galaxy whose arms wind with the bar phase and spin at the song tempo. Each note becomes a star lifted out of the disc plane by its exact tuning; roots burn gold.

shaders.name: Chromatic Wormhole
shaders.description: An endless twisted tunnel whose walls are living equalizer ribs — 64 bands mapped around the circumference. The twist tightens with loudness and every onset fires a shockwave ring past the camera.

shaders.name: Resonance Ocean
shaders.description: A raymarched ocean where each note drives a wave train at its exact root-relative ratio: consonance locks into glassy interference patterns, dissonance whitens the water with foam. Bass burns the horizon.

shaders.name: Beat Crystal Bloom
shaders.description: A crystal cluster grows from a mirror-black floor on every downbeat — one shard per note, tinted by pitch class, growing while sustained, all doubled in the obsidian below.

shaders.name: Harmonic Wave Sculpture
shaders.description: A kinetic gallery sculpture of helix strands — one per sounding note, twisted at its exact root-relative ratio so consonant chords braid into locked ribbons while the pedestal mirror-polish doubles the piece.

shaders.name: Neon Bass Canyon
shaders.description: A flight through a procedurally carved canyon striped with glowing equalizer veins; bass squeezes the walls together, beat lanterns drift upward, and notes hang as neon signs over the rim.

shaders.name: Score Monolith
shaders.description: A glossy slab on a mirrored plane under a dusk sky, whose face is the score: a bar-phase clock sweep, one glowing edge per sounding note flaring at attack, and laser beams drawn between harmonic links.

shaders.name: Synaptic Bloom
shaders.description: Notes sprout as glowing neurons drifting like plankton; harmonic links fire synapse pulses master to slave in beat-locked rhythm. Dissonant webs look tangled, consonant ones organized.

shaders.name: Chromatic Depth Pool
shaders.description: A pool of liquid color whose level breathes with loudness. Notes ripple outward at their exact pitch rate; refraction tints deepen with distance so low notes stain deep layers and high notes shimmer on top.

shaders.name: Gravity Well
shaders.description: A black hole with an accretion disc that is literally the mix: spectrum bands map across its radius with a Doppler-bright approach side. Notes orbit as particles — high notes whip around, bass crawls.

shaders.name: Beat Reactor
shaders.description: A kinetic containment atom around a volatile plasma core. The camera orbits continuously while three field rings precess at independent audio-driven rates, bright electron carriages race around them, and every transient kicks the mechanism out of phase.

shaders.name: Holo Foil
shaders.description: An embossed trading card with an animated rainbow foil. Approximate: not a physical diffraction model yet.
